resource.name: Print Studio
resource.description: Open-source browser tool maintained by Dario Rodighiero for composing screen-printing separations from collection visualizations. Its current Surprise Machines project represents 213,330 Harvard Art Museums images as colored marks. Supports A2/A3 sheets, one, two or three inks or CMYK, and 300/400 dpi PNG films with a color proof. Useful for teaching print production and communicating collection research; no general dataset-upload interface is documented.
